leadText:
Pikachu Shocks Back issue 1 is the fifth monthly issue of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu to be released by VIZ Media. It contains the fifth chapter of the manga, The Human Race and the Pokémon Race. 

The contents of this issue was included as part of along with ET06, ET07, and ET08.
